2122499431820091743.en_summary: (Reposted by @Jason) What does reusability unlock for SpaceX? Jason explains Elon’s analogy: if you destroy the plane after every flight from New York to LA, tickets would cost $500K. That’s why catching Starship matters so much. This is going to change everything.
2122499431820091743.zh_summary: (Reposted by @Jason) 可重用性為SpaceX帶來什麼？Jason解釋Elon的比喻：如果每次從紐約飛往洛杉磯後都銷毀飛機，機票將花費50萬美元。這就是為什麼捕捉Starship如此重要。這將改變一切。

ticker_notes.SPCX: 可重用性及捕捉Starship將大幅降低成本並改變太空飛行

2122496638019109038.en_summary: Morgan Stanley's Adam Jonas in new @SpaceX note: "Crickets after catch. SpaceX achieved one of the most important milestones in spaceflight history – and yet it’s pretty quiet out there. We understand there’s a lot of other stuff going on, but today was one of the quietest days for incoming SPCX call volume in weeks."
2122496638019109038.zh_summary: 摩根士丹利的Adam Jonas在新的@SpaceX筆記中表示：「捕捉後一片寂靜。SpaceX實現了太空飛行史上最重要的里程碑之一，但外界卻相當安靜。我們理解還有很多其他事情正在發生，但今天是數週以來SPCX來電量最安靜的一天之一。」

ticker_notes.SPCX: 重要里程碑後來電量異常低
